metadata.title: Why an Atom and a Laser Cavity Quantize for the Same Reason
metadata.thing: a wave between two walls — mismatched ones cancelling on reflection, fitted ones building a standing wave
metadata.color_notes: Surviving / fitted waves = accent Warm Slate #5A5653. The mismatched wave's non-zero ends + the 'cancels' emphasis = red #C0392B. Walls, baseline, ladder lines, labels = ink #1a1a1a.
metadata.reformat: center-cut, focus-aware; pantry/<bid>-916.* is the human replacement slot; -916 overrides honored

props.segment: Why an Atom and a Laser Cavity Quantize for the Same Reason
props.command: A laser emits only certain exact colors, and an atom holds only certain exact en

beats.narration_text: A laser emits only certain exact colors, and an atom holds only certain exact energies.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A laser emits only certain exact colors, and an atom holds only certain exact energies.
beats.new_visual_element: a person holding a laser pointer beside a glowing atom
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person holding a laser pointer in one view and a glowing atom in the other]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person looking between a laser pointer and a glowing atom]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person, a laser pointer, and a glowing atom draw in; the person looks between them; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: It turns out those two facts are really one and the same.
beats.tts_normalized_text: It turns out those two facts are really one and the same.
beats.new_visual_element: the person drawing an equals sign between the laser and the atom
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a laser pointer and a glowing atom with a big equals sign between them]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a laser pointer equals a glowing atom, the person nodding]
beats.video_animation_prompt: an equals sign draws in between the laser pointer and the glowing atom; the person nods; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Trap a wave between two walls.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Trap a wave between two walls.
beats.new_visual_element: two walls / mirrors with a gap
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw two vertical walls (mirrors) with a baseline between them

beats.narration_text: Pick a wave at random and it won't reach zero at the walls.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Pick a wave at random and it won't reach zero at the walls.
beats.new_visual_element: a mismatched wave with non-zero ends marked in red
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a mismatched wave that does not vanish at the walls; mark its non-zero endpoints with red dots

beats.narration_text: On each round trip it lands out of step with itself and cancels to nothing.
beats.tts_normalized_text: On each round trip it lands out of step with itself and cancels to nothing.
beats.new_visual_element: the wave and its reflected copy cancel to a flat line
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: bring in the reflected copy out of phase; transform both into a flat line; label 'cancels' in red

beats.narration_text: Only a wave that vanishes at both walls survives.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Only a wave that vanishes at both walls survives.
beats.new_visual_element: a fitted half-wave, zero at both ends (accent)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a fitted standing wave (one hump) that is exactly zero at both walls; mark the zero endpoints in accent

beats.narration_text: Now every round trip lands in step, reinforcing into a stable standing wave.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now every round trip lands in step, reinforcing into a stable standing wave.
beats.new_visual_element: the fitted wave pulses and locks in as a steady standing wave
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: pulse the fitted wave's amplitude to show reinforcement, then settle it as a steady standing wave; label 'reinforces'

beats.narration_text: Only a discrete set of waves fits — one hump, two, three, and so on.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Only a discrete set of waves fits — one hump, two, three, and so on.
beats.new_visual_element: a ladder of fitting modes n=1,2,3 stacked between the walls
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: stack the first three fitting modes (n=1,2,3) on dashed level lines between the walls

beats.narration_text: In an atom those surviving modes are the allowed energies; in a laser cavity they're the allowed colors.
beats.tts_normalized_text: In an atom those surviving modes are the allowed energies; in a laser cavity they're the allowed colors.
beats.new_visual_element: the same ladder tagged 'ATOM: energies' and 'LASER: colors'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: tag the ladder on the left 'ATOM: energies' and on the right 'LASER: colors'

beats.narration_text: Same fact, twice: only the waves that fit are allowed to exist.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Same fact, twice: only the waves that fit are allowed to exist.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle the ladder and write a red label 'only what fits survives'; clean close
